name: DongBang Medical
summary: DongBang Medical Co., Ltd., established in 1985 and headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea, is a prominent manufacturer and distributor specializing in a wide array of medical devices, bio medical solutions, cosmetic devices, and aesthetic fillers. The company's product portfolio includes hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers, marketed under brand names such as ELASTY GRAND, ELASTY DEEP PLUS, and ELASTY G PLUS, which are utilized for facial wrinkle improvement and volume restoration. They also offer various aesthetic threads, including ELASTY LINE, ELASTY MESHFILL, and ELASTY-V BARB, alongside essential medical consumables like cannulas, needles, and syringes. Beyond medical aesthetics, DongBang Medical provides an extensive range of skincare and haircare products. This includes moisturizing masks (Hyaluronic acid, Beta-Glucan), the FILL US patch, and specialized lines such as AG Solution (calming, defying, regenerating), AT Solution (cleansing, moisturizing, concentrated), AC Solution (clarifying, refining), and Hair Solution (shampoo, treatment, tonic), complemented by HA ESSENCE. Furthermore, their offerings extend to traditional healthcare items like hand acupuncture devices (e.g., hand acupuncture, spring hand acupuncture tube) and various other general goods such as pillows, charcoal, heat-resistant silicone, and cupping tools. DongBang Medical has a significant international presence, exporting its products to approximately 50 countries across North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East.
